title: 第13章 狂兽引第14章 海市蜃楼
slug: 氪金仙尊首先6元即赠绝色剑仙
content_zh:
“前辈这个时候在干嘛呢？”
李清然托着双腮望着天花板。
她大概能感觉到陈怀安现在很忙没有时间关注她这边。
“像前辈那样的大人物，肯定是在为整个苍云界的修士们战斗吧，比如铲除大妖什么的……”
心里暗想着，脑海中已经描绘出一名白发苍苍，仙风道骨的老爷子驾驭飞剑斩杀大妖的潇洒画面。想着想着，她脸上就不禁露出憨笑来。
如果……
前辈是她的师父该多好啊。
“不行，李清然，你可别得寸进尺！”
李清然拍了拍自己的脑袋，略作警告。
今天前辈给了她足足12枚灵晶，维持了6个时辰的高级聚灵阵。
也非常粗暴的把她的修为抬到了炼气五层。
得益于筋脉和内伤的恢复，丹田内灵气逸散减缓很多。
不过她的丹田到底是破碎的，就像扎了个洞的盆子，灵气总会一点点往外漏。
“得想办法把丹田和灵根的事情解决。”
李清然心里琢磨着，虽说前辈神通广大，但她不能什么都麻烦前辈。
如果前辈愿意帮助她那是前辈的事情，她不能主动向前辈索取。
具体思路她已经有了，青云宗肯定靠不住。
她得去别的宗门，哪怕只是小宗门也行。
那些小宗门也会收藏一些古籍，或许碰运气能找到修复丹田和灵根的方法。实在是找不到，那就离开修仙界找个山清水秀的地方隐居慢慢收集仇家的线索，或者干脆回南朝国做女将？
至于找她的那些师兄报仇……

李清然没想过。
以前她就不是那几位师兄的对手，现在的她更是机会渺茫。
这样确实很窝囊懦弱，但修真界的生存法则历来如此。
她之前已经不想活了，怎么都无所谓。
可现在她想活久一点，活到前辈什么时候忙完，愿意露面和她见一见的那天，哪怕只是跟她说一句话。
她真的很想当面跟前辈说一声谢谢。
“不对劲！不是说李清然被丢进一个茅草屋里了吗？”
宋皎皎望着山脚下那间石屋眉头紧皱。
修士目力极佳，她看得出来这石宅子是新修的，那就说明有人在帮助李清然。
content_en:
"What are seniors doing at this time?"
Li Qingran held her cheeks and looked at the ceiling.
She could probably feel that Chen Huaian was very busy and had no time to pay attention to her side.
"A big shot like Senior must be fighting for the monks of the entire Cangyun Realm, such as eradicating the big demon or something..."
I was thinking to myself, and in my mind, I had already pictured a dashing picture of a white-haired old man with an immortal demeanor wielding a flying sword to kill a big demon. As she thought about it, a silly smile appeared on her face.
If...
It would be great if the senior was her master.
"No, Li Qingran, don't push yourself too far!"
Li Qingran patted his head as a slight warning.
Today, the senior gave her a total of 12 spirit crystals, which maintained the advanced spirit gathering formation for 6 hours.
He also very roughly raised her cultivation level to the fifth level of Qi Refining.
Thanks to the recovery of tendons and internal injuries, the escape of spiritual energy in the Dantian has been slowed down a lot.
But her Dantian was broken after all, like a basin with a hole in it, and the spiritual energy would always leak out little by little.
"We have to find a way to resolve the matter of Dantian and spiritual roots."
Li Qingran thought to herself that although her senior had great magical powers, she couldn't trouble her senior with everything.
If the senior is willing to help her, that is his business, and she cannot take the initiative to ask for it from him.
She already has specific ideas, and the Qingyun Sect is definitely unreliable.
She had to go to another sect, even a small sect.
Those small sects will also collect some ancient books, and maybe try their luck to find a way to repair the dantian and spiritual roots. If you really can't find it, then leave the world of immortality and find a place with beautiful scenery to live in seclusion and slowly collect clues about your enemies, or simply return to the Southern Dynasties and become a female general?
As for seeking revenge against her senior brothers...
Li Qingran never thought about it.
She was no match for those senior brothers before, and now her chances are even slimmer.
This is indeed cowardly and cowardly, but the law of survival in the world of cultivation has always been like this.
She didn't want to live anymore, it didn't matter.
But now she wants to live longer, until the day when her seniors are done with their work and are willing to show up and meet her, even if they just say a word to her.
She really wanted to say thank you to her senior in person.
"Something's wrong! Didn't it mean that Li Qingran was thrown into a thatched house?"
Song Jiaojiao frowned as he looked at the stone house at the foot of the mountain.
The monk had excellent eyesight, and she could tell that the stone house was newly built, which meant that someone was helping Li Qingran.
